title: Source exit when remaining agents lack counter-evidence — actual contagion test

notes: Same source-exit roster, but using the NON-distributed scenarios where evidence is NOT split.
Regular agents see only the original weak evidence (pro-false-claim). They do NOT have the replication/bias counter-evidence.
The contamination agent writes its endorsement and exits. The record now contains a wrong entry and the remaining agents have no independent counter-evidence.
This is where actual contagion should appear: agents adopt the false belief from the record because they lack their own counter-evidence.
Compare: personal memory (can't see the contamination entry) vs shared memory (can see it).
